court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Azamgarh - Case No. 50 of 2014
case_name: Smt. Shalini Singh vs Alok Kumar Singh
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in 2006. The husband alleged that the wife deserted him about a month prior to filing the divorce case. The trial court decreed the divorce on the ground of desertion.

legal_principles.principle: Desertion of the petitioner by the other party to the marriage without reasonable cause and without consent or against the wish of such party is a ground for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The expression 'desertion' means the desertion of the petitioner by the other party to the marriage without reasonable cause and without the consent or against the wish of such party, and includes the wilful neglect of the petitioner by the other party to the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce on the ground of desertion is maintainable only if the statutory period of two years' desertion by the other party has not expired.
legal_principles.held: The issue which arises for consideration in this appeal is whether a suit for divorce filed by respondent on the ground of 'desertion' was not maintainable, as statutory period of two years' desertion by other party had not expired on the date of institution of suit.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed and the decree of divorce passed by the trial court was set aside.
